questions.prompt: They used to say that the old man mocked the young men.
questions.answer: Ajēbant senem juvenēs irrīdēre.

questions.prompt: You were saying that the service was both difficult and long.
questions.answer: Ajēbās ministerium et arduum et longum esse.

questions.prompt: The soldier was saying that he had seen the enemy in the woods.
questions.answer: Mīles ajēbat sē hostēs in silvīs vīdisse.

questions.prompt: We used to say that virtue must be sought by everyone.
questions.answer: Ajēbāmus virtūtem ab omnibus expetendam esse.

questions.prompt: You (pl.) were saying that the merciful king had spared the captives.
questions.answer: Ajēbātis rēgem misericordem captīvīs pepercisse.

questions.prompt: He says that the bite of the moray is dangerous.
questions.answer: Ait morsum murēnae perīculōsum esse.

questions.prompt: They say that they are seeking pure spring water.
questions.answer: Ajunt sē aquam putam fontānam expetere.

questions.prompt: I say that these things are wholly inexplicable.
questions.answer: Ajō haec omnīnō inexplicābilia esse.

questions.prompt: You say that the general informed the consul about the danger.
questions.answer: Aīs ducem cōnsulem dē perīculō certiōrem fēcisse.

questions.prompt: They used to say that the poet surpassed all the others.
questions.answer: Ajēbant poētam cēterōs omnēs praecēdere.

questions.prompt: You were saying that the olive was a sign of lasting peace.
questions.answer: Ajēbās olīvam pācis perpetuae signum esse.

questions.prompt: They say that the astonished crowd stood silent.
questions.answer: Ajunt turbam stupentem tacitam stetisse.

questions.prompt: He says that not one element is eternal.
questions.answer: Ait nūllum elementum aeternum esse.

questions.prompt: I say that the proposed reward is truly worthy.
questions.answer: Ajō prōpositum praemium vērē dignum esse.

questions.prompt: They were saying that the quality of the wine was pleasing.
questions.answer: Ajēbant vīnī quālitātem iūcundam esse.

questions.prompt: You say that you long for an arduous but glorious life.
questions.answer: Aīs tē arduam sed glōriōsam vītam expetere.

questions.prompt: The philosopher says that the mind ceaselessly seeks the truth.
questions.answer: Philosophus ait animum perpetuō vēritātem expetere.

questions.prompt: We were saying that the absent leader was greatly missed.
questions.answer: Ajēbāmus ducem absentem magnopere dēsīderārī.

questions.prompt: He says that the spy is watching the walls attentively.
questions.answer: Explōrātōrem mūrōs attentē cōnspicere ait.

questions.prompt: They say that the vehement orator has overthrown the opinion of the senate.
questions.answer: Ajunt ōrātōrem vehementem sententiam senātūs ēvertisse.

questions.prompt: I say that the aged priest prays to the divine powers.
questions.answer: Sacerdōtem annōsum nūmina dīvīna precārī ajō.

questions.prompt: You say that the wall was struck by unceasing waves.
questions.answer: Mūrum undīs assiduīs impāctum esse aīs.

questions.prompt: The soldier was saying that the fearsome enemy had been humbled.
questions.answer: Mīles hostem pertimēscendum humiliātum esse ajēbat.

questions.prompt: They were saying that the religious matron honored the gods with prayers.
questions.answer: Mātrōnam religiōsam deōs precibus honestāre ajēbant.

questions.prompt: We were saying that the deformity of the statue displeased the sculptor.
questions.answer: Dēfōrmitātem statuae artificī displicēre ajēbāmus.
